blocks.label: Sonar Watch
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Continuous PerformanceYou are on a long sonar watch. Most contacts are the common Kilo-877.
  • Click immediately when you detect the rare Shchuka-B (nuclear sub)
  • Do nothing for Kilo-877 contacts
  • You have 800ms to respond
  • Stay alert — targets appear only 20% of the time
